_about: Vostok v0.11 evening and rain (maps 272-275): the environment probes' light, nothing else. The probe cubes are 0.11e's own, byte for byte; 0.11e lights a probe texel as (c/a)^2.2, 0.26g's probe program as (c/a)^2 / 4 (its diffuse and specular taps both scale by 0.25) (docs/notes/v011-weather.md, "The darkness"). Rain, which exe patch 162 draws with 0.11e's sky, fog and skylight: diffuse and specular times four (diffuse 0.7 -> 2.8, specular 1 -> 4), 0.11e's light; at ten views rain display RMSE 0.0905 -> 0.0894. Evening, in 0.26g's own atmosphere: the diffuse times three (1 -> 3), as measured on 2026-11-12 and kept by the owner's eye (2026-11-19).
